competitor_evidence.text: Applied Materials, Inc. is the leader in the materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every semiconductor in the world.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Applied Materials, Inc. is the leader in the materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every semiconductor in the world.

competitor_evidence.text: We are experts in the design, development, production, and servicing of the critical wafer fabrication tools our customers need to manufacture semiconductors.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We are experts in the design, development, production, and servicing of the critical wafer fabrication tools our customers need to manufacture semiconductors.

competitor_evidence.text: The Semiconductor Systems segment consists of the semiconductor capital equipment industry’s most comprehensive portfolio of products used in the chip making process.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: The Semiconductor Systems segment consists of the semiconductor capital equipment industry’s most comprehensive portfolio of products used in the chip making process.

competitor_evidence.text: Our products address steps across materials engineering, process control and advanced packaging, including the conversion of patterns into device structures, transistor and interconnect fabrication, metrology, inspection and review, and packaging technologies for connecting finished IC die.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our products address steps across materials engineering, process control and advanced packaging, including the conversion of patterns into device structures, transistor and interconnect fabrication, metrology, inspection and review, and packaging technologies for connecting finished IC die.

competitor_evidence.text: Our patterning systems and technologies address challenges resulting from shrinking pattern dimensions and the growing complexity in vertical stacking found in today’s most advanced semiconductor devices.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our patterning systems and technologies address challenges resulting from shrinking pattern dimensions and the growing complexity in vertical stacking found in today’s most advanced semiconductor devices.

competitor_evidence.text: Our transistor and interconnect products and technologies enable continued power and performance improvements of 3D transistors.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our transistor and interconnect products and technologies enable continued power and performance improvements of 3D transistors.

competitor_evidence.text: Our process control systems employ optical and eBeam technologies that allow customers to inspect and review critical semiconductor architectures throughout the manufacturing process.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our process control systems employ optical and eBeam technologies that allow customers to inspect and review critical semiconductor architectures throughout the manufacturing process.

competitor_evidence.text: KLA CORP offers advanced packaging systems that utilize materials engineering expertise for heterogeneous integration of multiple chips.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our advanced packaging systems use our materials engineering expertise to allow customers to connect multiple chips together through heterogeneous integration.

competitor_evidence.text: KLA CORP's Semiconductor Systems sales target customers in the foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND flash memory markets.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our Semiconductor Systems sales are to customers that serve the following markets: foundry, logic and other; dynamic random access memory (DRAM); and flash memory (NAND).

competitor_evidence.text: KLA CORP serves customers producing on leading-edge technology nodes defined as 7 nanometers and smaller.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Leading-edge represents customers that are producing on the most advanced technology nodes, defined as 7 nanometers and smaller.

competitor_evidence.text: KLA CORP also serves customers in non-leading edge technology nodes for markets such as internet of things, communications, automotive, power, and sensors.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Non-leading edge technology nodes serve markets such as internet of things, communications, automotive, power and sensors.

competitor_evidence.text: Onto Innovation designs, develops, manufactures, and supports metrology and inspection tools for the semiconductor industry.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Onto Innovation® is a worldwide leader in the design, development, manufacture and support of metrology and inspection tools for the semiconductor industry.

competitor_evidence.text: The company provides process control tools that perform optical metrology and inspection on patterned and unpatterned wafers.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: including process control tools that perform optical metrology and inspection on patterned and unpatterned wafers,

competitor_evidence.text: Onto Innovation's products include macro defect inspection tools for both 2D and 3D wafer features.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: including macro defect inspection of both 2D and 3D wafer features,

competitor_evidence.text: The company offers wafer substrate and panel substrate lithography systems.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: wafer substrate and panel substrate lithography systems,

competitor_evidence.text: Onto Innovation provides process control analytical software used in semiconductor manufacturing.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: and process control analytical software.

competitor_evidence.text: Their products are used by silicon wafer manufacturers, semiconductor integrated circuit fabricators, and advanced packaging manufacturers.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our products are primarily used by silicon wafer manufacturers, semiconductor integrated circuit (“IC”) fabricators, and advanced packaging manufacturers operating in the semiconductor market.

competitor_evidence.text: The company offers solutions for process and yield management used in bare silicon wafer production and wafer processing facilities.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We provide process and yield management solutions used in bare silicon wafer production and wafer processing facilities,

competitor_evidence.text: Onto Innovation's systems measure critical dimensions, device structures, topography, shape, and various thin film compositions.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our automated and integrated metrology systems measure critical dimensions, device structures, topography, shape, and various thin film compositions,

competitor_evidence.text: The company focuses on products that provide critical yield-enhancing and actionable information for microelectronic device manufacturers.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our primary areas of focus include products that provide critical yield-enhancing and actionable information,

competitor_evidence.text: Onto Innovation's advanced process control software portfolio includes solutions for standalone tools and factory-wide suites.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: In addition, our advanced process control software portfolio includes powerful solutions for standalone tools, groups of tools, and factory-wide and enterprise-wide suites to enhance productivity and achieve significant cost savings.

competitor_evidence.text: The company acquired Semilab USA, adding advanced product lines for inline wafer contamination monitoring and materials characterization.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: In the fourth quarter of 2025, the Company acquired Semilab USA, which was a subsidiary of Semilab International Zrt., which added three advanced product lines—FAaST®, CnCV® and MBIR—to Onto Innovation’s portfolio, enhancing the Company’s capabilities in inline wafer contamination monitoring, materi

competitor_evidence.text: Manufacturers are looking to scalable technology to meet the growing demand at reduced average selling prices.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: In order to meet the growing demand at reduced average selling prices, manufacturers are looking to scalable technology.

competitor_evidence.text: Advanced packaging facilities are transitioning from 300mm wafers to large rectangular panels, which can be as large as 650mm x 650mm.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Advanced packaging facilities looking to improve Cost of Ownership and increase productivity are transitioning from 300mm wafers to large rectangular panels, which can be as large as 650mm x 650mm.

competitor_evidence.text: The JetStep® X500 lithography system is capable of processing RDLs on very thin advanced organic laminate panels in the semiconductor advanced packaging market.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: the JetStep® X500 lithography system, having emerged from the flat panel display market, is readily capable of processing RDLs on very thin advanced organic laminate panels in the semiconductor advanced packaging market.

competitor_evidence.text: The Firefly® series of panel level macro inspection tools is designed for high resolution inspection.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: The Firefly® series of panel level macro inspection tools, designed for high resolution inspection, can provide defect detection and location information to the JetStep X500 tool for each die.

competitor_evidence.text: The StepFAST™ process improves lithography throughput by providing defect detection and location information.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: which greatly improves lithography throughput using our exclusive StepFAST process.

competitor_evidence.text: Our metrology and inspection technologies provide process control for the majority of advanced node wafers processed today in a semiconductor wafer fab.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our metrology and inspection technologies provide process control for the majority of advanced node wafers processed today in a semiconductor wafer fab.

competitor_evidence.text: OCD metrology, thin film metrology, wafer stress metrology and macro defect detection and classification technologies allow yield enhancement for critical processes such as photolithography, diffusion, etch, chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) and outgoing quality control.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: In front-end processes, OCD metrology, thin film metrology, wafer stress metrology and macro defect detection and classification technologies allow yield enhancement for critical processes such as photolithography, diffusion, etch, chemical mechanical planarization (“CMP”) and outgoing quality contr

competitor_evidence.text: Within the back-end manufacturing processes, our 2D/3D advanced macro defect inspection provides our customers with critical quality assurance and process information.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Within the back-end manufacturing processes, our 2D/3D advanced macro defect inspection provides our customers with critical quality assurance and process information.
